# Interview P1: senior accountant, 9 years at the firm

Date: 2026-10-21. Remote call, 35 minutes. Notes taken live, quotes written down as said.

Month end starts on the last working day. She opens the reports page and one client at a time.

"I copy the rows into my spreadsheet line by line, it takes most of the morning."

She checks each row against the bank statement in the spreadsheet, not in Tallybook.

"If the order on screen changes between two clients I lose my place and start again."

Asked about exports in other tools: she used one at her last job but it dumped every client at once.

"A file with everything in it is no use to me, I only ever look at one client."

She would rather not get a new tool. Training the team took weeks last time.
